answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable bond before it can trade, like paying to berth at a crowded wharf. New identities begin on a narrow ledge of low trust and must earn throughput slowly as peers attest to real work. A Sybil swarm would then have to fund thousands of bonds at once, and each cloned identity grows no faster than a vine starved of sunlight, so the cost of faking many agents outruns any gain from the fraud.
